name: application-quiz-question-card
title: Quiz Question Card
description: Quiz question card with selectable answer options and a correct/incorrect reveal — correctness is determined by comparing the real selected option against the correct option id, not hand-styled per option.
useWhen: Presenting a single-choice quiz or assessment question with immediate right/wrong feedback.
You want the correct answer highlighted and the user's own wrong answer distinctly marked, both computed from real ids.
Options should lock (become non-interactive) once the answer is submitted.
avoidWhen: You need multi-select (checkbox) questions — extend the state model before reusing this single-select markup.
Answers shouldn't be revealed immediately (e.g. a timed exam) — gate the reveal behind a separate results screen instead.
You need free-text or code-based answers — this component is built for fixed multiple-choice options only.
responsiveBehavior: Options stack in a single column that reflows naturally to any container width; long option text wraps within its button.
accessibility: Before submission, options form a real role='radiogroup' of role='radio' buttons; after reveal, the role is dropped since options are no longer interactive.
Correct and incorrect states are marked with both color and explicit text ("✓ Correct", "✕ Your answer"), not color alone.
The Submit button is disabled until an option is selected, and all options become disabled after reveal to prevent changing the answer.

variants.title: Quiz question card
variants.description: HTTP status code question shown in its revealed state, with the correct option highlighted green and the user's wrong answer highlighted red, on a light surface.
accessibility: Only the correct option and the user's selected option carry extra labeling; unselected wrong options stay visually neutral.

variants.title: Quiz question card (Dark)
variants.description: The same revealed-state question, adapted for dark surfaces.
accessibility: Correct/incorrect option colors must meet WCAG AA contrast on dark backgrounds.
